q: Can I apply for MCA at MRIIRS if I did not study Mathematics?
a:
The published MCA eligibility criteria require a candidate applying through the B.Sc., B.Com. or B.A. route to have studied **Mathematics at either the 10+2 level or during graduation**, along with at least **50% marks or equivalent CGPA** (subject to the programme's current admission rules). Therefore, not having Mathematics at 10+2 does not automatically rule you out if you studied it during graduation. If you did not study Mathematics at either level, the published criteria do not show that route as eligible; contact Admissions for written confirmation before applying.
